__EMPTY: The Causal Taxonomy of AI Risks, adapted from Yampolskiy (2016), classifies risks by its causal factors (1) entity (human, AI), (2) intentionality (intentional, unintentional), and (3) timing (pre-deployment, post-deployment).

The high-level taxonomy makes it possible to use our database to, for instance, identify all mentions of risks which are presented as occurring pre-deployment or post-deployment, intentionally or unintentionally, and caused by AI or by humans, or any combination.
